name: ringcentral
label: RingCentral
description: Cloud business communications: send SMS, place calls, manage messages, and post to Team Messaging.

make_call.label: Make Call (RingOut)
make_call.description: Start a two-legged RingOut call: RingCentral calls the "from" number first, then connects it to the "to" number.

from.label: From
from.description: The number RingCentral calls first, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550100). Usually one of your RingCentral numbers.

to.label: To
to.description: The number to connect the call to, in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550123).

callerId.label: Caller ID
callerId.description: Optional number shown to the callee, in E.164 format. Must be one of your RingCentral numbers.

playPrompt.label: Play Prompt
playPrompt.description: Play a "please hold" prompt to the "from" party before connecting the call.

send_team_message.label: Send Team Messaging Post
send_team_message.description: Post a message to a RingCentral Team Messaging chat, group, or team.

chatId.label: Chat
chatId.description: The direct message, group or team to post to.

text.label: Message
text.description: The text content of the post. Supports Markdown.

get_call_log.label: Get Call Log
get_call_log.description: Retrieve call log records for the authenticated user's extension.

dateFrom.label: Date From
dateFrom.description: The start of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

dateTo.label: Date To
dateTo.description: The end of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z).

perPage.label: Records Per Page
perPage.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000).

get_extension_info.label: Get Extension Info
get_extension_info.description: Get profile information for the authenticated user's extension.

get_message.label: Get Message
get_message.description: Retrieve a single SMS, MMS or voicemail message, including the list of attachments it carries.

messageId.label: Message ID
messageId.description: The message to read. The New Inbound SMS or MMS trigger emits this as `id`.

download_message_attachment.label: Download Message Attachment
download_message_attachment.description: Download the content of a message attachment, such as an MMS photo or a voicemail recording, and return it as a file.

messageId.label: Message ID
messageId.description: The message the attachment belongs to.

attachmentId.label: Attachment ID
attachmentId.description: Which attachment to download. Leave blank to take the first one that is not the message text, which is the usual case for an MMS carrying a single photo.

fileName.label: File Name
fileName.description: Overrides the name RingCentral reports. Worth setting when the name matters downstream, e.g. naming a POD after the load number.
